scope: Real workerd, production relay + real Python CLI + remote MCP. Synthetic file executor, not Android SAF or phone acceptance.

checks.name: v4 discovery, no duration/command cap, enrollment and integrity-checked CLI delivery
CLI pair, pending denial, explicit full-phone persistent approval
workspace discovery and strict MCP schemas
real CLI upload/download verify multi-chunk binary with no base64 stdout
workspace sharing reaches CLI and MCP as unverified read-only handoff
read chunk and MCP binary resource retain authenticated metadata without base64 text
strict wire rejects traversal, foreign roots, extra fields, binary abuse and bounds before dispatch
CLI rejects local symlinks/directories and remote traversal, never overwrites outputs
corrupted chunk hash causes no local publication or content leak
uncertain chunk persists transfer identity, explicit resume checks status and does not duplicate bytes
empty file and same-transfer abort/finish idempotence
saved receipt does not falsely prove a subsequently changed file still matches
SAF flags are per-root and provider read-only denial is preserved
SAF publishing resumes its recorded document with one creation and fresh verification
SAF name-conflict cleanup is explicit and never deletes a finished neighbour
SAF unknown creation and expired receipt never trigger blind recreation or deletion
fresh sequence remains mandatory and revoke fences file HTTP/MCP access
